comparison: Perfect agreement on claims C7, C42-C44 regarding catalytic rate requirements (β/β₀ ≥ 10²-10³). Both evaluations find these claims SUPPORTED. OpenEval provides detailed model analysis while peer reviewers implicitly accept these quantitative estimates without challenge.

Complete agreement on claims C8, C37-C41 regarding fitness landscape and evolutionary dynamics. Both evaluations are SUPPORTED. OpenEval details the analytical and simulation evidence while peer reviewers accept the qualitatively new phenomena as technically correct.

Full agreement on claims C15-C17, C20-C21 regarding entropy reduction and hybridization. Both evaluations are SUPPORTED. OpenEval notes sound logic with limited quantitative detail; peer reviewers accept these claims as part of technically correct prior work.

Significant disagreement on claims C45-C50 regarding the VCG model comparison and scrambling problem. OpenEval finds claims SUPPORTED with clear documentation, while peer Reviewer 3 expresses UNCERTAINTY about whether scrambling is truly resolved and questions the scrambling-free length estimate.

Strong agreement on claims C4-C5, C33, C56-C57 regarding cooperative network structure and competitive advantage. Both evaluations are SUPPORTED. OpenEval provides detailed model analysis; peer reviewers confirm technical correctness and solid evidence. Note: C3 appears in OpenEval R2 but not peer R2.

Agreement on overlapping claims C2, C18-C19 regarding random cleavage generating primers and proliferation mechanism. Both evaluations are SUPPORTED. Peer R1 also includes C3, C24, C59 which OpenEval addresses separately. Both confirm solid model evidence.

Agreement on claims C6, C25-C28 regarding biological inspiration from hammerhead ribozymes. Both evaluations are SUPPORTED. OpenEval focuses on structural citations; peer R6 also encompasses experimental proposals (C12-C14, C53, C60) and notes positive connection to experimental scenarios.

Divergent evaluations of claim C29 regarding model dynamics. OpenEval rates UNCERTAIN due to inaccessible Appendix 1 analysis, while peer reviewers rate SUPPORTED, implicitly accepting the claim as part of overall technical correctness without examining the appendix.

Contrasting evaluations of experimental proposals C54-C55 (bidirectional polymerization). OpenEval rates UNCERTAIN citing biochemical problems and unclear feasibility, while peer reviewers rate SUPPORTED, accepting the assumption without challenge as part of technically correct model.

Partial overlap on claims C24, C59 regarding cleavage evolution. Both evaluations are SUPPORTED. OpenEval R11 also includes C60; peer R1 also includes C2-C3, C18-C19. Both accept the evolutionary argument with experimental support.

Partial overlap on background claims C12-C14 regarding RNA World hypothesis. Both evaluations are SUPPORTED. OpenEval R10 includes C9-C11 as well; peer R6 encompasses broader set including experimental aspects. Both accept foundational knowledge.
OpenEval evaluates claim C1 (dual nature of biological function) as SUPPORTED foundational knowledge. No corresponding peer review evaluation found for this framing claim.

Minor overlap on claim C53 (experimental approaches). OpenEval rates C53-C55 as UNCERTAIN due to feasibility concerns; peer R6 rates broader experimental set including C53 as SUPPORTED, noting positive connection to experimental scenarios.

Minor overlap on claim C60 (cleavage activity evolution). OpenEval rates C24, C59-C60 as SUPPORTED with evolutionary logic; peer R6 includes C60 in broader SUPPORTED evaluation of biological inspiration and experimental connections.
